name: sphior-code
description: Deterministic security scanning with skills that fix findings, triage false positives, set up CI and gate releases. Runs locally through the SPHIOR CODE CLI, no account needed.

interface.longDescription: Scans your code for hard-coded secrets, insecure patterns mapped to CWE and taint flows in 14 languages, with deterministic rules: the same code always gives the same result. Four skills fix the findings and re-scan to confirm, triage false positives with a written reason, set up a CI gate, and give a ready / not-ready verdict before release. Runs locally with the open-source CLI; no account, API key or source upload.
defaultPrompt: Scan this project for security issues and fix the critical ones.
Is this ready to ship? Run a pre-release security check.
